description: TodoApp - Simple full-stack todo list with React + Express in a single monorepo. Full CRUD surface with in-memory state, covered by integration tests.

userStories.title: Monorepo scaffold with server and client workspaces
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a monorepo layout with server and client workspaces so that subsequent stories can build on a consistent structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Root package.json declares workspaces for app/server and app/client
app/server has tsconfig.json with strict TypeScript and Express + TypeScript dependencies
app/client has tsconfig.json and Vite + React dependencies
Vite config in app/client proxies /api/* to http://localhost:3000
npm test script is wired at the root (can be a placeholder until US-006)
All code lives under app/ (Marmite convention)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Express server entry point with health endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Express server to start on port 3000 and expose GET /api/health so that later endpoints have a working host.
acceptanceCriteria: app/server entry point creates an Express app listening on port 3000
GET /api/health returns 200 with JSON body { ok: true }
All API routes are mounted under the /api prefix
Server can be started via an npm script (e.g. npm run dev --workspace=server)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: In-memory todo store and REST CRUD API
userStories.description: As a client, I need a full CRUD REST API for todos so that the UI can create, list, toggle, and delete tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: In-memory store holds todos with fields id (string), title (string), completed (boolean)
GET /api/todos returns 200 with Todo[]
POST /api/todos accepts { title } and returns 201 with the created Todo (id generated, completed=false, title trimmed)
POST /api/todos returns 400 when title is missing or empty after trim
PATCH /api/todos/:id accepts { completed } and returns 200 with updated Todo
PATCH /api/todos/:id returns 404 when id is unknown
DELETE /api/todos/:id returns 204 on success
DELETE /api/todos/:id returns 404 when id is unknown
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: React client app with todo list UI wired to the API
userStories.description: As a user, I want a web UI to view, add, toggle, and delete my todos so that I can manage my task list.
acceptanceCriteria: Vite dev server runs on port 5173 and serves a React App component
On mount the app fetches GET /api/todos and renders the list
An input + Add button POSTs a new todo; empty submissions are blocked client-side
Each row shows a checkbox that toggles completed via PATCH /api/todos/:id
Each row has a delete button that calls DELETE /api/todos/:id and removes the row
UI re-renders from server responses (no optimistic updates required)
Styling is minimal but the UI is usable
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: API integration tests for CRUD and validation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want integration tests covering the API so that regressions are caught by the verifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests start the Express app and exercise real HTTP endpoints (no mocked handlers)
Tests cover CRUD happy paths: create, list, toggle completed, delete
Tests cover the 400 validation case for POST /api/todos with empty/missing title
Tests cover the 404 cases for PATCH and DELETE with unknown ids
npm test from the repo root runs the suite and exits green
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
